landmark_cases.title: Delatte v. Lemotte
landmark_cases.reason: Articulates Louisiana’s requirement of strict adherence to La. R.S. 9:3550 when a premium finance company cancels a policy under a power of attorney.

landmark_cases.title: Eaglin v. Champion Insurance Co.
landmark_cases.reason: Establishes that any defect in following the premium-finance cancellation statute renders the cancellation ineffective.

landmark_cases.title: Britten v. Reavis
landmark_cases.reason: Explains the doctrinal purposes of strict statutory compliance—fixing the exact time of cancellation and preserving a cure period.

landmark_cases.title: Hodges v. Colonial Lloyd’s Insurance
landmark_cases.reason: Addresses cancellation ‘upon receipt’ of the finance company’s notice and statement, informing the receipt/trigger mechanics under La. R.S. 9:3550.

landmark_cases.title: Jefferson v. Lead Industries Ass'n
landmark_cases.reason: Provides the Fifth Circuit’s general standard on when to certify questions to a state supreme court, relevant to the panel’s refusal to certify.
